title: Make ops-refs-vault implement repo-specific bare SSOT to single forge backup
summary: The desired canonical route is local working clone -> repo-specific bare SSOT on nixos-vm -> single forge backup roccho-dev/refs by namespaced refs. The previous ops-refs-vault implementation still centered local working clones and did not expose backup-one/backup-all/restore-bare-one/promote-staging-bare as the contract-required route.
doneWhen: backup-one backs up one repo-specific bare source branch to refs/heads/repos/<repoId>/<branch>
backup-all reads manifest sourceBarePath values and backs up all source bare branch refs
restore-bare-one restores one repoId/branch from forge backup into a staging bare repo
promote-staging-bare updates a target bare repo only with explicit --confirm
audit, verify-one, and inventory operate on repo-specific bare sources and one forge backup
local working clone paths are rejected as canonical backup sources
default backup is no-force and rejects diverged forge refs
smoke-local emits proof ids P01 through P11
proofPlan: P01 local working clones can update repo-specific bare SSOT repos by normal git push
P02 backup-all reads manifest sourceBarePath and backs up repo-specific bare SSOT repos
P03 repoId and branch map to refs/heads/repos/<repoId>/<branch>
P04 audit sees expected repoId namespaces in the single forge backup
P05 verify-one compares source bare hash with forge backup hash
P06 inventory emits machine-readable bare SSOT rows
P07 restore-bare-one restores exact repoId/branch into staging bare
P08 missing branch restore fails instead of falling back to main
P09 promote-staging-bare updates target bare only after --confirm
P10 local working clone paths are not accepted as canonical backup source
P11 default backup is no-force and rejects diverged forge refs

title: Make ops-refs-vault implement repo-specific bare SSOT to single forge backup
summary: ops-refs-vault now implements the route as branch-only bare-to-bare backup and restore: local working clones update repo-specific bare SSOT repos separately; backup-one/backup-all push those bare refs into one forge vault under refs/heads/repos/<repoId>/<branch>; restore writes to staging bare first; promotion into SSOT requires --confirm. The package is checked against specs commit 2e3d05dae25ee9000eda53028e1a6f2ecf8a341c.
evidence: nix run .#ops-refs-vault -- smoke-local: pass and emitted P01 through P11
notApproval: not proof that GitHub is SSOT
does not preserve dirty/untracked/ignored files, secrets, or build cache
